name: The Wanderer
blurb: A placeholder playbook showing every section type. Copy it to make real ones.

sections.title: Background
sections.help: Choose one. Your background grants a starting move.

options.label: Trailhand
options.text: You learned the roads by walking them.

options.label: Returned
options.text: You left for years and came back different.

sections.title: Instinct
sections.help: Mark XP at end of session when you acted on it.

sections.title: Name
sections.help: Pick a list, then a name, or make one up.

options.label: A worn map
options.text: Advantage to Recall Lore about routes.

options.label: A storm lantern
options.text: Never goes out in wind or rain.

options.label: I have been farther than anyone else here.
I lost someone on the road.
Someone in the village owes me.

sections.title: Current goal
sections.placeholder: What are you after right now?

moves.name: Well Traveled
moves.text: When you **Recall Lore** about a place you have visited, take advantage.

moves.name: Trailsense
moves.trigger: When you lead the way through country you do not know...

outcomes.10+: You find the way, and hold 2 Focus.
outcomes.7-9: You find the way, and hold 1 Focus.

hold.name: Focus
hold.note: Spend 1 Focus to notice something before it notices you.

moves.name: Sharp Tongue
moves.trigger: When you Sway someone with something they want...

outcomes.10+: As Sway, and they owe you.

moves.name: Watchful
moves.text: You always notice an ambush before it springs.

moves.name: Iron Gut
moves.text: You can eat anything. ◇◇◇ mark one each time you do; when full, clear and take +1 HP max.

moves.name: Tireless
moves.text: Requires Trailsense. You never tire on the road.
